_comment: Source of truth for the curated SLO alerting system. Consumed by scripts/gen_grafana_alerts.py -> alerting/grafana/*.json, provisioned by scripts/grafana_provision.py. SEPARATE from the triage-bot escalation_score machinery. Design: references/architecture/alerting-system-design.md; status: ...-status.md. NEVER put Slack webhook URLs or passwords here. v2: rewritten to verified InfluxDB schemas; only SLO-4/5/7 are live (InfluxDB-backed, queries verified to return data); the rest are deferred (see build_status).

meta.paging_target: slack-only for now. A Grafana 'XMatters' contact point exists; route P1 there ONLY after this system proves value AND the user authorizes it.
meta.routing_note: Every rule carries notification_settings.receiver=triage-bot-health, delivering DIRECTLY to that contact point and BYPASSING the shared notification-policy tree (whose default receiver is #alert-system). We make zero edits to the shared policy.

latency.note: rtcapi_request stores StatsD timing aggregates (count/mean/upper/...), NO true p95. Alert on mean('mean'); baseline ~171ms.

owner.owner_note: runtime-core split across 3 teams by host — see ownership_gaps; primary owner to confirm.

latency.note: approutine_actions timing aggregates; no response_code tag (errors would need ES). Baseline ~24ms.

slos.verified: haserror=true 1 / total 10831 over 24h (2026-06-18). Reframed from 'backlog age' (no such field) to sync error-rate.

slos.reason: Depends on applogs-es; auth log fields/tags not yet confirmed. Revive after an es_search.py mapping probe.

queries.error: service:(ms-authentication-api OR ms-gateway-api) AND tag:auth AND (level:Error OR status:>=500)

slos.reason: Depends on applogs-es gateway logs + status-code field name. Revive after confirming ms-gateway-api logs to applogs-es with status codes.
Depends on applogs-es designer save log signature. Low-volume -> absolute count rule when revived.
No gateway latency metric exists in any reachable datasource (no gateway_metrics InfluxDB; Prometheus only self-monitors). Needs a gateway request-duration metric to be emitted first.
eda_metrics is a BUSINESS-event stream (AccountCreated, RecordUpdated...), not RabbitMQ broker telemetry. No subscriber heartbeat / consumer lag anywhere reachable. Needs a RabbitMQ exporter.
No DLQ-depth metric in any reachable datasource (eda_metrics is business events). Needs a RabbitMQ exporter.

ownership_gaps: runtime-core is one deployable split across 3 teams by host (runtime-core-api->Vertical App Experience, runtime-core-subscriber-api->CRM Experience, designer-core-api->No Code Next Gen); a single pool-stop (F6) hits all three — needs a designated primary owner / cross-team bridge.
DevOps team has no TeamSlackAlertChannel webhook in the ownership grid — infrastructure alerts have no eventual team channel (the one true orphan).
Components/projects mapped to teams not in the Teams grid: Impact, Stock Apps, Internal, Logstash, blank/Department.
Vertical App Experience and Transactions share one webhook (B063S8NBW0M).
ms-search-api vs runtime-core Method.Search alias ambiguity.
